== Summary ==
Commentators at the streaming desk on Sunday afternoon. The poster's caption names [[Steve Baroni]] as one of them but does not say which one.

* '''Event:''' [[2022 World Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2022-10-16
* '''Camera date:''' 2022-10-16 15:00 (time of the post)
* '''Identification:''' the people are not named in the post.

Posted in the #worlds-2022 channel of the Players Committee Slack (starwarsccg.slack.com) by Yoshi, 2022-10-16. Original file name: IMG_0480.jpg (3024×4032); Slack file id F046T8NAVFE.
* '''Photographer / posted by:''' [[Sam Tashima]] (Slack: Yoshi)
